options.text: These are common visible adolescent changes.
The same change need not appear at the same age or to the same extent for every classmate.
A classmate whose voice changes later than others is developing abnormally.
A swollen ankle after a fall is a normal adolescent growth change.

stem:
Zara notes visible changes among classmates over several months: increased height for many, broader shoulders for some, a deeper voice for one friend, a few pimples, and new underarm hair for some.

Which claims are correct? One or more options may be correct.

teacher.key_rationale: Height, body structure, voice, pimples, and new body hair are common adolescent changes, and timing and extent vary. Later voice change is still normal variation; an injury swelling is not an adolescent growth change.
